rivals.name: Sora Matsuda
rivals.appearance: slim; cropped hair; oversized delivery vest over striped sleeves; round key reel
rivals.personality: friendly fast talker who remembers everybody's order but forgets his own gloves
rivals.strength: preserves speed in open third-gear bends
rivals.weakness: overprotects momentum in very slow hairpins
rivals.introSample: A clean exit buys more than a brave entrance.

rivals.name: Hanae Okuno
rivals.appearance: broad shoulders; tied locs; canvas apron folded over dark overalls; ceramic pin
rivals.personality: a potter who treats practice as craft and finds boasting mildly funny
rivals.strength: stable brake release and repeatable entries
rivals.weakness: gives away space to committed late overtakes
rivals.introSample: I can do that corner again. Can you?

rivals.name: Kei Naruse
rivals.appearance: tall; asymmetric bob; cropped rain cape; checker cuff and ankle boots
rivals.personality: patient map collector who gets unexpectedly competitive about sector traces
rivals.strength: strong uphill exits and wet stability
rivals.weakness: carries too little speed into long sweepers
rivals.introSample: The map ends. The next bend does not.

rivals.name: Toma Fujii
rivals.appearance: stocky; curly high top; patched racing cardigan; bright laces
rivals.personality: a bicycle mechanic learning to trust four wheels without hiding his nerves
rivals.weakness: brakes too early under pressure
rivals.introSample: I fixed the brakes. Now I have to stop apologizing to them.

rivals.name: Yui Morisaki
rivals.appearance: petite; short side-swept hair; fitted bomber with tool-loop belt; enamel moth badge
rivals.personality: a night-shift technician with dry humour and meticulous notebooks
rivals.strength: protects legal inner lines without swerving
rivals.weakness: sacrifices exit when defending too long
rivals.introSample: There is room. It just is not where you hoped.

rivals.name: Akio Endo
rivals.appearance: heavyset; shaved head; long work coat over knitwear; flour-dusted shoes
rivals.personality: an easygoing baker who dislikes being mistaken for an easy opponent
rivals.strength: finds composed lines across rough transitions
rivals.weakness: slow to commit to a narrow passing opening
rivals.introSample: The road has a crust too.

rivals.name: Noa Ishida
rivals.appearance: athletic; braided undercut; sleeveless utility layer; large translucent watch
rivals.personality: a candid volunteer timekeeper who loves tidy data and untidy jokes
rivals.strength: links alternating corners with little steering correction
rivals.weakness: loses rhythm after an unexpected slow sector
rivals.introSample: That was almost a sentence. Try the next corner.

rivals.name: Daigo Ibuki
rivals.appearance: very tall; salt-and-pepper crop; rolled-sleeve shop jacket; heavy brass stopwatch
rivals.personality: first lieutenant; generous teacher who will not congratulate careless speed
rivals.strength: deep but controlled braking into tight turns
rivals.weakness: long gears leave a weak exit when baited into overbraking
rivals.introSample: Do not follow my brake lights. Find your own marker.

rivals.name: Rika Aonuma
rivals.appearance: long limbs; high ponytail; fitted waterproof smock; asymmetric reflective piping
rivals.personality: a botanist who notices changing grip before anyone notices rain
rivals.weakness: less decisive on a rapidly drying ideal line
rivals.introSample: Listen to the tyres, not the weather report.

rivals.name: Masato Kido
rivals.appearance: compact muscular build; swept-back hair; padded vest with narrow trousers; thumb ring
rivals.personality: a former courier who turns every trip into a carefully timed promise
rivals.strength: sets up two corners in advance for acceleration
rivals.weakness: can be surprised by a slower tightening apex
rivals.introSample: I promised I would arrive. I did not promise quietly.

rivals.name: Airi Shiba
rivals.appearance: short; twin braids; long knit scarf tucked safely into a short jacket; star barrette
rivals.personality: a music student who counts corners like phrases and hides frustration poorly
rivals.weakness: rushes the first turn after a mistake
rivals.introSample: You changed the beat. Good.

rivals.name: Rui Takeda
rivals.appearance: lean; shaved sides; quilted poncho shape; broad goggles at collar
rivals.personality: a reserved trail photographer with surprising appetite for a clean overtake
rivals.strength: turns wide setup into strong exits
rivals.weakness: gives away an inside opportunity on narrow roads
rivals.introSample: There is a better angle from out here.

rivals.name: Fumio Senda
rivals.appearance: round silhouette; moustache; short waxed coat; repair patches and knitted cap
rivals.personality: a forest-road maintainer protective of newcomers, impatient with excuses
rivals.weakness: conservative high-speed commitments
rivals.introSample: That patch was not there yesterday. It is there now.

rivals.name: Ena Kisaragi
rivals.appearance: tall angular build; close-cropped silver-dyed hair; long split-hem jacket; geometric earrings
rivals.personality: a sound engineer who hears a bad shift and cannot resist mentioning it
rivals.strength: keeps the engine in the useful band uphill
rivals.weakness: rarely risks a sudden alternate line
rivals.introSample: Your engine asked a question. You changed the subject.

rivals.name: Itsuki Hase
rivals.appearance: broad chest; wavy shoulder-length hair; sleeveless padded coat; stitched wristwrap
rivals.personality: a relaxed climber whose driving becomes exceptionally precise near exposure
rivals.strength: repeatable safe arcs on narrow elevated roads
rivals.weakness: lets an aggressive but clean rival dictate entry pace
rivals.introSample: Close to the edge is not the same as in control.

rivals.name: Emi Takanashi
rivals.appearance: medium height; coiled bun; long storm-grey coat with a distinctive asymmetric collar; cedar clasp
rivals.personality: second lieutenant; courteous meteorologist with a fierce dislike of lazy assumptions
rivals.strength: anticipates traction changes from surface and camber
rivals.weakness: dry-road maximum pace is less intimidating
rivals.introSample: The rain is not against you. It is information.

rivals.name: Shun Minato
rivals.appearance: slim; short curls; utility jumpsuit tied at waist; orange tape on one glove
rivals.personality: dam electrician, cheerfully impatient until precision is required
rivals.weakness: slow direction changes in the heavy chassis
rivals.introSample: Make the current work for you.

rivals.name: Kaede Ueno
rivals.appearance: tall strong build; long braid; cropped technical coat; silver mechanical pencil
rivals.personality: civil drafter, observant and gently sarcastic about extravagant racing lines
rivals.weakness: rigid commitment makes variable-radius bends awkward
rivals.introSample: You drew that line with your elbow.

rivals.name: Michi Kagawa
rivals.appearance: short rounded silhouette; fluffy hair; wide sleeves on a fitted waistcoat; water-level tag
rivals.personality: archivist who loves old mistakes because they make good warnings
rivals.strength: restores pace quickly after a slide
rivals.weakness: occasionally accepts a risk that was not necessary
rivals.introSample: I know this mistake. It has a good ending.

rivals.name: Ryo Senba
rivals.appearance: athletic; topknot; open-collar workshop tunic; narrow rectangular spectacles
rivals.personality: quiet machinist who explains little and demonstrates a great deal
rivals.weakness: needs clean braking on downhill entries
rivals.introSample: Watch the release, not the turn.

rivals.name: Natsumi Hori
rivals.appearance: compact; jagged bob; thick short jacket over tapered trousers; oversized headphones at neck
rivals.personality: radio editor who speaks in concise observations rather than slogans
rivals.strength: stays close without contact and waits for an error
rivals.weakness: can overinvest in following instead of passing
rivals.introSample: You looked in the mirror twice there.

rivals.name: Kenta Omi
rivals.appearance: large build; receding hair and beard; high-collar vest; fabric lunch bag
rivals.personality: maintenance supervisor with a long memory and infectious laugh
rivals.weakness: braking distance can be exploited
rivals.introSample: Good. Now do it when your hands are tired.

rivals.name: Sae Tsukada
rivals.appearance: long silhouette; straight waist-length hair in a low tie; tailored coveralls; thin red belt
rivals.personality: hydrologist, laconic until someone mistakes caution for fear
rivals.weakness: loses time when the radius unexpectedly tightens
rivals.introSample: The wide line only works when it comes back.

rivals.name: Jun Saegusa
rivals.appearance: slender; close shave; long white mechanic's coat with dark inner panels; small steel caliper
rivals.personality: third lieutenant; exacting builder who gradually admits that numbers need interpretation
rivals.weakness: predictable committed line gives a patient rival an opening
rivals.introSample: Measure twice. Brake once.

rivals.name: Hiroto Namioka
rivals.appearance: tall; loose swept hair; deck jacket with broad shoulder stripes; rope bracelet
rivals.personality: ferry mechanic, restless on land, hospitable in the garage
rivals.weakness: impatient through slow compound corners
rivals.introSample: The long way can still be the quick way.

rivals.name: Maya Kuroda
rivals.appearance: strong compact build; sharp bob; short leatherless racing jacket; triangular earrings
rivals.personality: poster artist who enjoys making an overtake look inevitable
rivals.weakness: stubborn defence can consume front grip
rivals.introSample: I left you a space. Not the one you chose.

rivals.name: Renji Sudo
rivals.appearance: broad; greying braided hair; long fisherman-style work coat; knitted wrist cuffs
rivals.personality: a patient boat repairer with an unexpectedly explosive sense of humour
rivals.weakness: boost can punish a rushed exit
rivals.introSample: That gear was a choice. Make it a good one.

rivals.name: Koharu Akiyama
rivals.appearance: very short; cropped curls; oversized varsity-style windbreaker; shell-shaped clip
rivals.personality: a dancer who treats the road as rhythm but hates being called naturally gifted
rivals.weakness: hesitates on isolated late-braking hairpins
rivals.introSample: It took practice to make that look easy.

rivals.name: Seiji Tanabe
rivals.appearance: thin and stooped; long untidy hair; layered rain jacket; folded harbour timetable
rivals.personality: night dispatcher, soft-spoken and impossible to hurry in conversation
rivals.weakness: gives away top-end aggression
rivals.introSample: There is still time to do the corner properly.

rivals.name: Akane Furuya
rivals.appearance: tall athletic; side braid; sleeveless quilted coat over bright undershirt; square medallion
rivals.personality: fitness instructor who is direct, supportive and intensely competitive
rivals.weakness: can be baited into a poor exit gear
rivals.introSample: You can be brave after you are accurate.

rivals.name: Yori Kamei
rivals.appearance: medium broad build; shaved head; long open utility shirt; woven pouch
rivals.personality: ceramic sign painter who prefers clever positioning to showing force
rivals.weakness: rarely capitalizes on a short straight alone
rivals.introSample: I am not rushing you. The finish is.

rivals.name: Mako Hoshino
rivals.appearance: tall; windswept short hair; dramatic cropped cape-like race jacket; copper ear cuff
rivals.personality: fourth lieutenant; charismatic former champion whose bravado protects a careful strategist
rivals.weakness: can sacrifice a straight by overrotating for style
rivals.introSample: Show me the line you would choose without an audience.

rivals.name: Tetsu Arimura
rivals.appearance: square build; close buzz cut; split-tone workshop suit; magnetic parts band
rivals.personality: test engineer who believes a repeated result is more interesting than a lucky one
rivals.weakness: predictable decisions under pressure
rivals.introSample: One good lap is a story. Three are evidence.

rivals.name: Chika Sakurai
rivals.appearance: slim; long asymmetric ponytail; high-waisted overalls; bright measuring-tape sash
rivals.personality: upholsterer with a sharp eye for a car's balance and a sharper wit
rivals.weakness: gives away early entry speed
rivals.introSample: The seat is comfortable. Do not get comfortable.

rivals.name: Naozumi Fuda
rivals.appearance: long-limbed; full beard; old racing waistcoat; repaired driving gloves
rivals.personality: engine builder, proud of naturally aspirated response and grudgingly fair about turbo cars
rivals.weakness: less aggressive in crowded opening sectors
rivals.introSample: Power is useful. Wasting it is expensive.

rivals.name: Lina Hayase
rivals.appearance: short athletic; tight curls; sculpted padded jacket; transparent tool pouch
rivals.personality: a bilingual workshop coordinator who translates everyone's excuses into useful tasks
rivals.strength: quick correction without a second overcorrection
rivals.weakness: sometimes relies on recovery instead of avoiding the first mistake
rivals.introSample: That is recoverable. Your pride may take longer.

rivals.name: Osamu Kitani
rivals.appearance: large relaxed build; side-parted grey hair; long shop apron over a knit vest; magnifier
rivals.personality: veteran tuner with elaborate tea preferences and very simple racing advice
rivals.weakness: less flexible when forced off his planned rhythm
rivals.introSample: The engine is not tired. You chose the wrong ratio.

rivals.name: Tsubasa Muraoka
rivals.appearance: tall narrow silhouette; spiked fringe; cropped reflective jacket; fingerless cuff on one arm
rivals.personality: industrial designer who loves experiments and keeps their failed prototypes
rivals.weakness: overexperiments on a closing-radius corner
rivals.introSample: The usual line was getting lonely.

rivals.name: Ayame Sugiura
rivals.appearance: medium build; short blunt fringe; tailored long vest; dark oval glasses
rivals.personality: quality inspector who notices an inconsistency before she notices a compliment
rivals.weakness: can be outpaced by someone who ignores the pressure
rivals.introSample: You were quicker before you started watching me.

rivals.name: Reina Kurogane
rivals.appearance: tall poised silhouette; sleek chin-length black hair; sharply tailored white-and-graphite race coat; single red seam
rivals.personality: Normal final boss, The Surveyor; believes solitary precision is the only reliable form of trust
rivals.strength: near-perfect linked braking and repeatable legal pace
rivals.weakness: commits too strongly to an ideal line when a different rhythm is needed
rivals.introSample: A convoy still reaches the corner one driver at a time.

rivals.name: Fuyu Tachibana
rivals.appearance: small; thick bob under a fleece cap; long insulated vest; mountain-flower patch
rivals.personality: observatory assistant whose nervous chatter disappears when driving
rivals.strength: clear judgement on narrow highland roads
rivals.weakness: overcautious through broad lowland corners
rivals.introSample: I can see the exit. That is enough.

rivals.name: Kazuma Yorita
rivals.appearance: broad stooped build; tousled grey curls; cable-knit jacket; old radio receiver
rivals.personality: radio repairer who heard the legendary run and refuses to embellish it
rivals.strength: sensitive to camber and cold-road transition
rivals.weakness: does not enjoy aggressive defending
rivals.introSample: The quiet part is where you hear the car.

rivals.name: Neri Takase
rivals.appearance: long angular silhouette; braided crown; asymmetrical long windbreaker; constellation brooch
rivals.personality: hiking guide who laughs at heroic stories but quietly makes sure everyone returns
rivals.weakness: needs discipline at blind-seeming but marked braking zones
rivals.introSample: Leave yourself a road home.

rivals.name: Satoshi Mibe
rivals.appearance: compact; shaved scalp and short beard; quilted jumpsuit; cloth-wrapped thermos
rivals.personality: snow-shed technician with blunt manners and an excellent memory for apprentices
rivals.weakness: loses flow across a long gentle sector
rivals.introSample: The marker is there for a reason. Then there is your reason.

rivals.name: Minae Otsuka
rivals.appearance: broad athletic; high knot; short heavy coat over narrow trousers; mountain rescue whistle
rivals.personality: former endurance mechanic who values consistency and checks other cars before her own
rivals.strength: low-waste lines over a long event
rivals.weakness: rarely uses a surprising short-term attack
rivals.introSample: Keep some of the car for the last hill.

rivals.name: Gaku Nishio
rivals.appearance: very tall thin; shoulder-length silver hair; old flight-style coat; round spectacles on cord
rivals.personality: retired train driver whose jokes arrive late and whose braking never does
rivals.weakness: modest power requires perfect exits
rivals.introSample: On time is a kind of fast.

rivals.name: Yuna Senzaki
rivals.appearance: short muscular; blunt cropped hair; loose mechanic's shirt; two embroidered glove cuffs
rivals.personality: a restoration specialist rebuilding the old dawn car with respect rather than nostalgia
rivals.weakness: tries too hard when the legend is watching
rivals.introSample: Old does not mean finished.

rivals.name: Shiori Kuze
rivals.appearance: compact upright silhouette; silver braid; worn indigo driving coat; repaired cream scarf tucked safely away
rivals.personality: Hard final boss, Zero Signal; the legendary dawn racer, patient and unshowy, testing observation rather than bravado
rivals.strength: extraordinary legal speed preservation, minimal steering and measured late release
rivals.weakness: lower power makes any actual loss of flow costly; no magical recovery
rivals.introSample: You do not have to hurry every part of the road.
